name: aggregates
description: A register-research project's aggregate results, in long form: person counts by groups, statistics by groups, and regression coefficients. A file the project does not use is written with zero rows. A share is exported as counts per outcome category (both the numerator and its complement are cells), never as a ratio: the format-1 policy cannot check a ratio's numerator.

files.name: counts.parquet
files.description: Persons per cell. table names the output (a table or figure in the paper); year and group_1 to group_3 are its keys, null where a table has fewer. A share is two or more rows here, one per outcome category.

files.name: statistics.parquet
files.description: One statistic per row (a mean or a quantile of a variable), on the distinct persons it is computed from. statistic names it, for example mean_income or p50_income; it is not a ratio of a binary variable.

files.name: coefficients.parquet
files.description: One regression term per row. n_persons is the distinct persons in the estimation sample, n_obs its rows (person-years, say). A term identified by a small group (a dummy for few persons) reproduces that group's mean; the reviewer checks this.
